inputBounds.money: canonical non-negative two-decimal strings, at most ten integer digits
inputBounds.quantity: non-negative JS safe integer; aggregate must remain safe

temporal.stockAsOf: equal to period.endExclusive for this synthetic reference pair
temporal.interpretation: period statistics beside an end snapshot; no historical stock or through-period membership inference

grains.stockSelection: explicit product/size x warehouse Cartesian set; exact key coverage required; not all stock in the store

semantics.membership: active status9 at the snapshot only; eligible or inactive membership is not currently advertised
semantics.statisticsCompleteness: all selected campaign/product pairs have explicit rows and exact sum to the corresponding campaign statistics total
semantics.stockCompleteness: complete flag and exact declared grain coverage; missing is not zero
semantics.onHand: sum quantity only, each stock grain once; exclude transit
semantics.spendPlacement: product/campaign statistics stay once per product; never copied onto size/warehouse stock rows
semantics.actualCost: CAMPAIGN_SPEND_PRODUCT_ALLOCATION_UNDEFINED; currency remains null because no source currency binding is proved
semantics.costHistoryCompleteness: partial actual-cost history remains incomplete and does not block otherwise complete statistics x stock

normalization.campaigns: promo_campaigns id -> advertId, nm_settings.nm_id -> nmIds; currency is campaign metadata, not proof for cost ledger
normalization.statistics: promo_fullstats days.date/apps.appType/apps.nms.nmId/apps.nms.sum; currency bound by fullstats response
normalization.actualCostHistory: promo_spend_history advertId/updSum; sourceRowRef is a synthetic capture reference, not an invented provider field; no currency/product allocation inferred

consumerBoundary: Technical source contract and synthetic input for A; no browser, provider requests, business-answer tuning, pipeline integration, readiness TSV or existing gold definition changes
